name: astro-spa
description: An Astro JS component that turns a website into an SPA and boost performance using various techniques

paragraphs: The Six UI frameworks supported by Astro for templating are primarily used for building Single Page Applications. But the application it generates isn't a SPA.
So to enjoy the advantages of a SPA, you can install Astro SPA to turn your existing Astro project into SPA. It's not only just a SPA component/library but it comes with many other features also.
Why Astro SPA? It's a good question. Well, Astro SPA is a SPA component/library that is built using Astro components. That means, it utilizes all the exclusive features of Astro components!
features: Prefetching is a feature that allows you to load the page content before the user visits it for blazing-fast navigation. Prefetching is enabled by default. So, you can enjoy the benefits without having to worry about…

Astro SPA prefetches the internal links using the Intersection Observer API. So, it won't start prefetching until the user reaches the link and thus it saves bandwidth. It also upgrades to fetch requests on mouseover…
If you want to disable prefetching, you can do so by tweaking the prefetch prop to false.
